newsitem.title: UK: UK Japan stocks firmer in quiet pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: UK Japan stocks firmer in quiet pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading here took a firmer overall bias in thin volumes ahead of public holidays over the next two weeks, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 was 0.55 points up at 1,513.9 by 1343 GMT.
Dealers reported buying interest in Citizen Watch, up 21 yen from the Tokyo close to 862 yen, after news of a 10 billion yen share buy-back.
Sony rose 20 yen to 9,100 yen amid buying interest, they said.
"We've seen shares move away on the offer side but no real business behind it," said one dealer. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4026
